crossRefs.note: Simon, whom he also named Peter; Andrew, his brother; James; John; Philip; Bartholomew;
Going on from there, he saw two other brothers, James the son of Zebedee, and John his brother, in the boat with…
Then the mother of the sons of Zebedee came to him with her sons, kneeling and asking a certain thing of him.
They beckoned to their partners in the other boat, that they should come and help them. They came, and filled both…
As for Titus, he is my partner and fellow worker for you. As for our brothers, they are the apostles of the assemblies…
It will happen, that every living creature which swarms, in every place where the rivers come, will live. Then there…
It will happen, that fishermen will stand by it. From En Gedi even to En Eglaim will be a place for the spreading of…
He said to them, “Come after me, and I will make you fishers for men.”
“Again, the Kingdom of Heaven is like a dragnet, that was cast into the sea, and gathered some fish of every kind,
Jesus said to them, “Come after me, and I will make you into fishers for men.”
They were all filled with the Holy Spirit, and began to speak with other languages, as the Spirit gave them the ability…

translations.web: and so also were James and John, sons of Zebedee, who were partners with Simon. Jesus said to Simon, “Don’t be afraid. From now on you will be catching people alive.”
translations.bsb: and so were his partners James and John, the sons of Zebedee. “Do not be afraid,” Jesus said to Simon. “From now on you will catch men.”
translations.kjv: And so was also James, and John, the sons of Zebedee, which were partners with Simon. And Jesus said unto Simon, Fear not; from henceforth thou shalt catch men.
translations.asv: and so were also James and John, sons of Zebedee, who were partners with Simon. And Jesus said unto Simon, Fear not; from henceforth thou shalt catch men.
